tests.command: xperl-install install with this patch set and GraphQL #10 (targeted rerun)

failure: t/ajax.t "GraphQL with die" failed on XPerl; the original passes on Perl 5.44. When a route handler dies, the plugin builds { errors => [ { message => $@ } ] } and sends it as JSON. On XPerl $@ is an XPerl::Exception object, which the JSON encoder cannot serialize, so the client receives an empty body instead of the error. The patch stringifies $@ for the message. The patch also skips the Makefile.PL rule that regenerates README.md with pod2markdown (a develop-only prereq) outside a git checkout: patching the module makes it newer than README.md, so an install build would otherwise run pod2markdown, fail, and leave README.md empty.
